content:
來自 Gentler Weather Sounds 的獨立雨聲音效

雖然我非常喜歡我製作的 Gentler Weather Sounds（並強烈推薦大家使用！），但也明白完全替換未必符合所有人的口味。因此，這個資源包只提供雨聲音頻！

在較舊的版本中，資源包選單可能會顯示警告，但音效能正常運作至 1.7 版本！

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

使用的音效 未列名出處的音效均由我設計與錄製 所有音效均已調整編輯，以確保搭配更和諧 [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/rain-and-thunder-nature-sounds-7803/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/rain-and-thunder-nature-sounds-7803/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/soft-rain-ambient-111154/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/soft-rain-ambient-111154/) [https://freesound.org/people/shelbyshark/sounds/513394/](https://freesound.org/people/shelbyshark/sounds/513394/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/copyright-free-rain-sounds-331497/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/copyright-free-rain-sounds-331497/) [https://freesound.org/people/Soundrack/sounds/733288/](https://freesound.org/people/Soundrack/sounds/733288/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/calm-rain-ambience-421001/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/calm-rain-ambience-421001/) [https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/nature-soft-distant-rain-with-birds-for-sleep-432019/](https://pixabay.com/sound-effects/nature-soft-distant-rain-with-birds-for-sleep-432019/)
